newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly steady in brisk OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly steady in brisk OTC trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed the week mostly steady in brisk trade on the Varazdin over-the-counter market on Friday.
* Five of 12 traded issues rose, two fell and four were flat.
* 10-stock VIN index up 113 points or 1.25 pct to 9,182.
* Top gainer Ilirija Banka rose 6.67 percent to 50 marks on volume of 50 shares.
* Most active with 485 shares was hotel firm Jadranturist, up 2.67 percent to 77 marks.
* Bigger of the two decliners, confectioner Kras, lost 6.47 percent to 130 marks on volume of 244 shares. It was higher at 140 marks during the session. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
